unit_title: ምዕራፍ ፯ — Meraf 7: Grand Master of ከ and ኸ

success_screen.headline_en: Spectacular! You are the Grand Master of ከ and ኸ!
success_screen.headline_am: ግሩም ድንቅ ነው! የከ እና የኸ የደረጃ ፫ ዋና ጠቢብ ሆኑ!

games.title: Grand Decoder: KOKEB
games.instructions_en: Match the native English phonetic spelling 'KOKEB' (Star) with the correct Amharic word.

games.title: Grand Finish: ኮከብ
games.instructions_en: Look closely at the word 'Star' (Kokeb). Find the correct missing first letter: [ ? ]ከብ.
games.tips_en: The full word is ኮከብ (pronounced Ko-ke-b).

games.title: Master Sequence Check
games.instructions_en: Grand Master skip pattern! Look at the pattern: 1st form ➔ 3rd form ➔ 5th form ➔ [ ? ] (7th form). What goes next?

games.title: Grand Builder: ኮከብ
games.instructions_en: Assemble the letters correctly to spell the Amharic word for Star (Kokeb)!
games.tips_en: Tip: Select 7th form 'ኮ', first form 'ከ', and end in 6th form 'ብ'!

games.title: Grand Decoder: KEK
games.instructions_en: Match the phonetic spelling 'KEK' (Cake) with the correct Amharic word counterpart.

games.title: Grand Audio Blend: ኽ
games.instructions_en: Listen closely to the breathy native 6th form 'Xh' sound of the ኸ family. Which symbol matches this silent form?

games.title: Grand Builder: ኸምር
games.instructions_en: Form the full Amharic word for Grapes/Wine Jar (Xhemr)!
games.tips_en: Tip: Select 1st form 'ኸ', follow with 6th form 'ም', and end with 6th form 'ር'!

games.title: Grand Decoder: XHEMR
games.instructions_en: Match the native English phonetic spelling 'XHEMR' with the correct Amharic word.
